audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Akali wins every stage while content, packet and 51.24% WR (2666 games) all say Xerath — pre-6 she has no gap-closer at all and even post-item the lane stays Xerath-sided if he respects the all-in.
audit.why: Data layers contradicted each other on every row.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides flipped to Xerath to agree with content win[] and the packet chart.

audit.why: Spikes correct: Lvl 3-5 uncontested poke, her 6 (Shuriken Flip + Perfect Execution), your Luden's spike outpacing her multi-item curve, late flank threat. 'Shuriken Flip' in spikes[1] is the REAL ability name — suspectNames flag is a false positive.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; Perfect Execution's re-cast execute and the Assassin's Mark auto-reset tell (both in missingInteractions) were unmentioned.
audit.why: Shroud is 20s at rank 1, her E 16s at rank 1, her R 120/90/60 — real windows the page should name; her R re-cast executes, so low HP near her is lethal beyond what the bar suggests.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added; execute and auto-reset tell folded where length allowed, rest in notes.

notes: Full-layer chart had all seven rows 'Akali' while content win[] and the packet chart had all seven 'Xerath' — the whys under the full rows already described Xerath winning, so the sides were flipped to Xerath with matched why rewrites; no content edits needed. suspectNames flagged 'Shuriken Flip' in spikes[1].text but that IS the real E name — false positive, left alone. Missing interactions folded in: Perfect Execution re-cast execute (dontsFull[2].d), stun-the-dash peel (dosFull[1].d). The Assassin's Mark auto-reset tell (step back on her empowered-auto wind-up) did not fit any lint-flagged field's length band and was left unwritten rather than expanded — candidate for a future report[5] rewrite. Akali uses energy, not mana; no current text claims otherwise. Ratings left untouched (semantics undocumented). sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, enemyWin still structurally templated; no grounded Akali-specific replacement fit the band without inventing.
